moneyCosts.title: Costs
moneyCosts.sub: The month's fixed costs and the daily cost lines the shop sends the ERP with its daily summary.
moneyCosts.notLinked: Costs go to the ERP from the day this store switches to the new ERP contract (v6). Until then nothing here can be entered or sent.
moneyCosts.readOnly: You can see the costs. Entering them needs the "Set fixed costs" permission.

fixed.title: Fixed costs
fixed.sub: Salary, rent, utilities and other costs of a whole month. The ERP spreads them over the days of the month, exact to the paisa, with the remainder on the last day. They never go into a day's other costs.
fixed.notePh: For example: salary raised from this month
fixed.saved: Saved as version {n}. It goes to the ERP within a minute.
fixed.same: Nothing changed: these are already the month's numbers.
fixed.fromLast: Filled in from {month}. Check every line, then save.
fixed.empty: Not set yet. Write each line; write 0 for a cost the shop does not have.
fixed.needAll: Write every line as an amount (0 for none).

lines.title: Daily cost lines
lines.sub: Costs of one day that go into that day's summary: packaging, accessories, payment and COD fees, courier, ads and other. Enter them for today or an open day; an earlier day already sent goes to the ERP again by itself.
lines.addedResent: Added. The day's summary was built again and goes to the ERP.
lines.badAmount: Write the amount (0 means none that day).
lines.none: No cost entered for the open days yet.
lines.reversedOk: Reversed. Enter the right amount again if needed.
lines.neverTitle: Cost lines this shop never has
lines.neverSub: A ticked line counts as 0 on days with no entry, instead of "not in yet".

err.FORBIDDEN: You do not have the permission for this.
err.BOOKS_NOT_LINKED: The books with the ERP have not started for this store yet.
err.BOOKS_DAY_CLOSED: That day or month is no longer open in the books.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Something is not filled in right. Check the amounts and the day; an amount far above the usual is refused as a typing slip.
err.CONFLICT: This cannot be reversed (already reversed, a reversal, or from a statement).
err.NOT_FOUND: That entry is not there any more. Open the page again.

moneyCosts.never: Nothing here moves money. A cost is never changed or deleted: a wrong one is reversed and entered again.
